label: Twitch
terms_note: Free; Helix needs Client-Id + OAuth token; chat send = user token with user:write:chat or app token with user:bot + channel:bot (the broadcaster must authorize channel:bot or mod the bot); 20 messages / 30 s (100 for mods / VIPs / broadcaster), 1 message/s per channel for non-privileged accounts, verified bots 7,500 / 30 s; whispers user:manage:whispers 40 rps, 3/s per user, 100 unique recipients per day; concurrent join limit 100 chat rooms; Developer Agreement bans spam and unsolicited whispers.

tools.name: publish_video
tools.endpoint: — (no upload API; clips are created from a live stream: POST helix/clips)

tools.name: read_comments
tools.endpoint: EventSub `channel.chat.message` (WebSocket or webhook) — there is no REST “read chat” endpoint

tools.name: read_mentions
tools.endpoint: same EventSub chat events (filter on the channel/bot name)

tools.name: dm_read
tools.endpoint: — (no endpoint returns received whispers; EventSub has no whisper event for third parties)

tools.name: delete
tools.endpoint: DELETE helix/moderation/chat (delete a chat message) · DELETE helix/videos

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.endpoint: — (no per-message metrics; GET helix/clips / helix/videos carry view counts)

tools.name: analytics_account
tools.endpoint: GET helix/channels/followers (total) · GET helix/streams · GET helix/analytics/games (CSV report URLs)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (chat + channel data; no feed posts).
auth: 1. Twitch developer console app → OAuth 2.0 authorization code (user token) or client credentials (app token).
2. Chat bot pattern: the bot account grants `user:bot` (+ `user:write:chat`, `user:read:chat`), the broadcaster

endpoints.purpose: 40 rps, 3/s per user, 100 unique recipients / day
total always; details need moderator scope

reference.limits: - Chat: 20 messages / 30 s (100 for broadcaster / mods / VIPs), 1 msg/s per channel unprivileged, verified bots 7,500 / 30 s; join limit 100 chat rooms per account. - Helix: 800 points per minute per client bucket (`Ratelimit-Limit / -Remaining / -Reset`). - Free; Developer Agreement + Community Guidelines (no spam, no unsolicited whispers, bots must identify).

adapter.rate_note: Helix token bucket of 800 points per minute per user token; chat messages additionally follow chat rate limits (20 per 30 s as a regular user, 100 per 30 s as moderator/broadcaster).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Twitch app client id (dev.twitch.tv console); also sent as the Client-Id header required on every Helix call.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Twitch app client secret (form body of the refresh request to https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/token).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: User refresh token from the authorization-code flow with scopes user:write:chat and moderator:manage:chat_messages. 'Because refresh tokens may change, your app should safely store the new refresh token': the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/twitch.json (mode 0600).

config_fields.name: broadcaster_id
config_fields.help: User id of the channel whose chat is used (GET /helix/users?login=…).

config_fields.name: sender_id
config_fields.help: User id of the token's user (GET /helix/users with the token); sender of messages and moderator for delete.

me.note: Get Users without ids returns the token's user (account.data[0]: id, login, display_name).

publish_text.note: Sends a chat message (max 500 characters) to config broadcaster_id's chat. A message that fails AutoMod or chat settings answers 200 with raw.is_sent=false and raw.drop_reason — check is_sent.

reply_comment.note: Chat reply: `comment_id` is the chat message id being replied to (reply_parent_message_id). Check raw.is_sent.

delete.note: Deletes ONE chat message (`post_id` = message id; created within the last 6 hours, not the broadcaster's or another moderator's). message_id is always sent: without it Twitch 'removes all messages in the broadcaster's chat room'.

not_offered.publish_image: Chat messages are text and emotes only (Send Chat Message takes `message` text, https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/api/reference/#send-chat-message); there is no image upload.
not_offered.read_comments: There is no REST endpoint to read chat; messages arrive through EventSub channel.chat.message (WebSocket or webhook, https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/eventsub/eventsub-subscription-types/).
not_offered.read_mentions: Mentions are only visible in the EventSub chat stream (https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/eventsub/eventsub-subscription-types/); no REST feed exists.
not_offered.analytics_post: Chat messages have no metrics endpoint; Helix analytics endpoints return CSV report URLs for extensions and games (https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/api/reference/#get-game-analytics).

evidence: probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
